solution_principle: Surface choice depends on input: Direct Surface: closed planar curves only. Boundary Surfaces: closed curves needing planar fill. Network Surface: when you have curves in TWO perpendicular directions (U and V). Patch Surface: when you have scattered curves/points and need an approximation (tolerance-controlled). Network Surface is the most controlled (exact interpolation), Patch is the most flexible (approximate fit).
